meaning: Accepted reusable CLI scopes on simlox/main. The catalog-v2.json planning snapshot is intentionally frozen and its legacy publication_state fields are not current publication decisions. Each evidence document defines the actual accepted behavior and limits. Unlisted cases and variants are not implied to be published.

A03 two-hour formation with one SPECIAL mission resource per aircraft at capacities two, one and zero: two launches and releases; one partially reserves then cancels and releases; zero reserves none and cancels. One-hour catalog form, distinct preparation resource and multiple resource types unverified

A03 two-hour formation with crew capacity two and a distinct radio required per aircraft: radio capacity two books both types per aircraft and releases at completion; radio capacity zero blocks both types from booking and cancels at deadline. Asymmetrical capacity, one-hour form and ground preparation resource unverified

A03 two-hour formation with MISSION-CREW held from assignment to completion and distinct GROUND-TECH used only for half-hour preparation: ground capacity two releases tech before launch; ground capacity zero cancels waiting preparation at 7.83333 and releases reserved mission crew. One-hour form, ground capacity one and turnaround unverified

C03 two-aircraft 20-minute preparation with P-CREW primary and P-ALT alternative: primary available uses 20 minutes despite ARTF two; primary absent uses alternative for 20 minutes at ARTF one or 40 minutes at ARTF two, shifting launch to 8.16667. Probabilistic need, multiple alternatives and both unavailable unverified

C06 fixed two-aircraft preparation with P-CREW and P-ALT capacities both zero: both requests fail at 7.5, formation cancels at 8.66667, waiting tasks stop and both aircraft return ready; no resource booking, work or inventory movement. Other deadlines, partial capacities, multiple alternatives and probabilistic need unverified

C06.var04 endpoint pair from the both-resource-zero model: RPROB zero lets two 20-minute preparation subtasks perform with no typed resource allocation and formation succeeds 8-9; RPROB one demands unavailable resources, waits and cancels at 8.66667. Intermediate probabilities and sampling behavior unverified

C06.var04 twelve fixed-seed one-replication RPROB=0.5 observations at zero primary/alternative capacity: native per-aircraft demand patterns NN/ND/DN/DD occur 4/3/3/2, mixed cases cancel at 9, both-demand cases at 8.66667, neither-demand missions succeed 8-9. Counts do not establish a probability law or independent sampling

one first-day two-crew shift from 7.75-10: DRAOS=Y books both crew off shift at 7.5 and completes preparation at 8, while DRAOS=N waits for 7.75, completes at 8.25 and incurs positive resource waiting; both missions succeed at 9 versus 9.25. Long cross-shift pause/resume, QTY-one, missing-row, recurring/overlap and full C07 remain unverified

two explicit first-day one-crew shifts at 8-9 and 10-11 against nominal crew two, with two-hour preparation from 7.5: DRAOS=Y works off shift, one aircraft pauses 8-9, both complete and 12-13 mission succeeds; DRAOS=N pauses active work for positive 9-10 gap, resumes first aircraft at 10 and cancels unprepared two-aircraft mission at 13. Recurrence, absent ShiftResource, overlap, MAXUT and full C07 remain unverified

one DRAOS=Y, two-crew, two-shift first-day comparison: explicit ShiftResource QTY0 and omitted resource row produce byte-identical native event logs and equal result tables except description; both crews stop during 8-9 and 10-11 shifts, resume off shift, finish two-hour preparation at 11.5 and succeed 12-13. Missing rows for multiple resources, DRAOS=N, recurrence/overlap, MAXUT and full C07 remain unverified

one DRAOS=N elapsed-hour-24 crossing: explicit two-crew shifts 23-24 and 25-27 pause both two-hour preparations at 24, resume at 25, finish at 26.5, and the two-aircraft mission succeeds 28-29; four crew-hours work, two resource-hours waiting. A named calendar weekend, weekly recurrence, overlap, MAXUT and full C07 remain unverified

one DRAOS=N pair of explicit two-crew shifts 119-120 and 168-170 separated by a 48-hour inactive gap: both aircraft pause preparation at 120, resume at 168, finish at 169.5 and succeed on a 171-172 formation; four crew-hours work and 96 resource-hours waiting demand. A named calendar weekend, automatic weekly recurrence, overlap, MAXUT and full C07 remain unverified

one DRAOS=N first-day 23-25 and 26-28 shift pair encoded as explicit rows, direct IQTY2/IINT3 repetition, or a repeated nested subprofile: three native event logs byte-identical and result tables equal except description; both aircraft pause preparation 25-26 and succeed 28-29. Weekly recurrence, deeper nesting, overlap/capacity errors, MAXUT and full C07 remain unverified

one explicit shift overlap rejected with error #250, one repeated-interval overlap rejected with errors #249/#250, and one QTY3 active shift above nominal two warned #60 and clamped to effective two with valid native result equivalent to QTY2 control; generic invalid-shift handling and full C07 remain unverified

one two-crew no-active-shift daily MUTILF comparison: default control and station override1 have identical events and succeed 28-29; Resource MUTILF0 prevents work and mission cancels27; finite .03125 allows 0.75 hour per crew/day, stops both at24.75 after day reset and mission cancels29. General daily/shift utilization and full C08 remain unverified

one fixed-seed two-crew MAXUT1 active shift with 23-25 and 26-28 windows: both aircraft pause two-hour preparation at 24.5 with one hour left, resume at second shift start 26, finish at 27 and succeed 28-29; four crew-hours work, three resource-hours waiting. Daily MUTILF, station override, partial pool and full C08 remain unverified

paired fixed-seed one-versus-two busy crew in a two-person shift pool: two single-aircraft preparations start 23.5 and 24; MAXUT1 reaches the two-crew-hour budget at 24.75 and stops both with 0.75/1.25 hours left, then resets at 26 and both missions succeed. Other stagger patterns and full C08 remain unverified

one fixed-seed two-crew MAXUT1 boundary: one-hour subtasks complete and release crew at 24.5 exactly at the first-shift pool limit; no time-out or second-window work; formation succeeds 28-29, two crew-hours total and zero resource waiting. General equal-time priority, partial-pool demand and full C08 remain unverified

one seeded P-CREW operational failure at 7.73494, repaired at 7.98494: two-crew preparation stops and mission succeeds at 9.25; with one idle spare it continues and mission succeeds at 9. This pair does not test calendar clocks or off-shift spares; full C10 remains unverified

one seeded RFTT OPERATION-to-CALENDAR comparison: calendar crew failures occur during idle 0-7.5, while the operational parent has none; three calendar task stops delay formation success to 9.47761, and one crew remains failed at the 36-hour horizon.
